prompt: make some creative decisions to turn every other element on the screen into something visually interesting. each should be its own mod.

messages.text: make some creative decisions to turn every other element on the screen into something visually interesting. each should be its own mod.

ran ls sites/timsrobot.com; trif mods | grep timsrobot; trif run 'return [...document.querySelectorAll(".hero .small, h2, section.two > div, footer")].map(e=>({tag:e.tagName,cls:e.className,text:e.textContent.trim().slice(0,50)}))'

The tagline, robot, title and buttons are done, which leaves four things on the page. My plan, one mod each:

- **"Free and open source"** → sticker badges that pop in
- **What you need** → a checklist you can tick
- **Yours, on your computer** → a little terminal window
- **the footer** → a scrolling LED sign
ran trif new timsrobot.com stickers && trif new timsrobot.com checklist && trif new timsrobot.com terminal && trif new timsrobot.com led
A mod can't read your disk, so the terminal can't run a real `ls`. It'll list the mods in your side panel for this site instead, so it keeps up as you make more.

ran for m in stickers checklist terminal led; do trif check timsrobot.com/$m || break; done && trif reload && trif errors; for s in ".sb-row" "ul[data-nc]" "[data-tb]" footer; do trif run "document.querySelector('$s').scrollIntoView({block:'center'})"; trif screenshot; done
All four run with no errors. The LED dots are too small to read on a small screen, so I'm making them bigger.
ran trif reload && trif errors; trif run 'document.querySelector("footer").scrollIntoView({block:"center"})'; trif screenshot -o led.png

Done: four new mods, one for each part of the page that was left.

- **Sticker Badges:** "Free and open source" is now three tilted stickers (green, yellow and pink) that pop in one after another.
- **Need Checklist:** **What you need** is a checklist with an icon for each item. The boxes tick themselves when you scroll to it, and you can click them to tick or untick.
- **Terminal Box:** **Yours, on your computer** is a little terminal window. It types out `ls ~/.trif/sites/timsrobot.com` and lists the mods we've made.
- **LED Footer:** the footer is an amber LED sign, with its links scrolling past.

**What I checked:** after a reload, all four ran with no errors, and the screenshots of each part look right. If your system is set to reduce motion, they keep still.

Each one has its own switch in the side panel, so you can turn any of them off.

texts.17: Four new mods: the “Free and open source” line is sticker badges, **What you need** is a checklist, **Yours, on your computer** is a terminal, and the footer is an LED sign.
